blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Fire struck at Baguio’s New Lucban Extension on Tuesday morning (Sept. 29), injuring three people and displacing 14 families (56 individuals). The fire broke out at around 8:28 am, engulfing several residential units and business establishments, according to Baguio City Fire Marshall F/Supt. Mark Anthony Dangatan. READ: A metropolis takes shape around Baguio Dangatan said two civilians, who assisted in supressing the blaze, and a firefighter were hurt. The Baguio City Fire Station is investigating the cause of the fire. The fire was placed under control at 9:10 a.m. and declared out at 9:25 am. Firefighters continued mopping-up […]...
